summary: Take your marketing skills to the next level with our data analytics training. Learn how to harness the power of data for targeted marketing campaigns.
lede: Marketing data analytics uses customer and campaign data to measure performance and guide marketing decisions. The training is for professionals who need to assess, optimize, and report on results across digital and traditional channels. It covers configuring GA4 conversion tracking, calculating ROAS, segmenting audiences with RFM analysis, and comparing campaign attribution models.
audienceIntro: This comprehensive training is structured for professionals who are responsible for measuring, optimizing, and reporting on marketing performance across digital and traditional channels.
modules: Core Financial Metrics and ROI Measurement
AI in Marketing and Executive Reporting
prerequisites: Working knowledge of basic marketing concepts and intermediate spreadsheet skills (e.g., VLOOKUP, Pivot Tables). No programming, SQL, or advanced statistical experience is required. Participants must bring a laptop with internet access to participate in the dashboarding exercises.
